candidates.name: Amendment 1: Budget Stabilization Fund (HJR 5019)
candidates.source_name: Florida Division of Elections Constitutional Initiatives (official list); Florida TaxWatch for summary
candidates.notes: Raises Budget Stabilization Fund cap from 10% to 25% of prior-year general revenue and requires annual transfers; referred by Legislature. Official list shows serial numbers (1)-(3) and titles; amendment numbering per TaxWatch (secondary), confirm against certified ballot. Needs 60% to pass.

candidates.name: Amendment 2: Exemption of Tangible Personal Property on Agricultural Land from Taxation (HJR 1215)
candidates.source_name: Florida Division of Elections Constitutional Initiatives (official list); Florida TaxWatch for summary
candidates.notes: Referred by Legislature. Official list shows serial numbers (1)-(3) and titles; amendment numbering per TaxWatch (secondary), confirm against certified ballot. Needs 60% to pass.

candidates.name: Amendment 3: Increased Homestead Exemption; Lower Cap on Increases in Non-Homestead Property Assessments (HJR 1F)
candidates.source_name: Florida Division of Elections Constitutional Initiatives (official list); Florida TaxWatch for summary
candidates.notes: Referred by Legislature; summary from Florida TaxWatch (secondary): non-school homestead exemption to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028, non-homestead cap 10% to 5%. Official list shows serial numbers (1)-(3) and titles; amendment numbering per TaxWatch (secondary), confirm against certified ballot. Needs 60% to pass.
